text: Accessible parking permit holders have qualified for an accessible parking permit through the Ministry of Transportation after meeting criteria for having a disability from a list of five disability types. Many people living with a disability are also among the population living with a limited income. Due to this, those holding accessible parking permits are exempt from a range of on-street parking related fees but not front yard parking fees. As a matter of equity, the City of Toronto should investigate to establish whether an exemption from front yard parking fees should also be supported.
The Public Works and Infrastructure Committee deferred consideration of the item indefinitely.
